subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Bluebeard's Chamber
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Bluebeard's Chamber.

hook.text: A rich man gives his wife all his keys. One door she must never open. She opens it immediately.

buildup.text: Behind the door: the bodies of previous wives. The key stains with blood that won't wash off.

discovery.text: The forbidden room is the unconscious. The bloody key marks whoever gains dangerous knowledge.

twist.text: Curiosity isn't the villain. Bluebeard is. The tale warns against blind obedience, not questioning.

climax.text: The wife escapes through cleverness. Forbidden knowledge becomes survival knowledge.

punchline.text: Open every door. Even that one.

quiz.question: What does the wife find behind Bluebeard's forbidden door?
